summary.en: Messages go to the selected conversation or task. Slash commands operate locally; help never calls a model.
summary.zh-CN: 消息发送给当前选中的会话或任务。斜杠命令在本地处理；帮助不会调用模型。

en: Read the prompt focus before sending: main is the main conversation; a task ID targets that child. /current shows the exact focus; /switch main returns to main.
/status reads the current focus. /history shows only the last 10 main-conversation messages; /clear clears the display, not stored history.
/help tasks lists all existing task controls. /help viewer and /help provider open local guidance. To send literal text beginning with /, type // instead; one leading slash is removed.

In a terminal, a trailing backslash continues a message. Ctrl+C at the input prompt reminds you how to leave; /quit, /exit or EOF leave Basic without stopping child tasks. During execution, use the existing pause/recovery contract.
zh-CN: 发送前先看输入区的目标：main 是主会话，任务 ID 是对应子任务。/current 显示精确目标；/switch main 返回主会话。
/status 查看当前目标状态。/history 只显示主会话最近 10 条消息；/clear 清屏但不删除已保存的历史。
/help tasks 列出原有任务控制；/help viewer、/help provider 打开本地说明。要发送以 / 开头的原文，先输入 //；系统只去掉第一层斜杠。
终端输入行末尾的反斜杠表示续行。输入提示处按 Ctrl+C 会提示退出方式；/quit、/exit 或 EOF 离开 Basic，不停止子任务。执行期间沿用原有暂停与恢复机制。

summary.en: The viewer reads recorded evidence. Changing the view never starts, resumes, stops or repairs a task.
summary.zh-CN: Viewer 读取已记录的证据。改变视图不会启动、恢复、停止或修复任务。

en: Start with Overview to identify which agents do the work. Detailed flow and PetriNet expose the actual conditions, places and arcs; an overview link is not proof that the path ran.
Select a step, then About, Executions or Evidence. Use exact references in Evidence to locate the underlying record.
Search and Locate change focus; Fit to view restores the complete current projection. Resources shows declared dependencies only in supporting views.
Use /task ID status and /task ID result in Basic for task status and its registered result. Settled records and an output place alone do not prove success.
zh-CN: 先用概览识别承担工作的 agent；详细流程与 PetriNet 展示实际条件、库所和弧。概览连线不能证明这条路径已经执行。
选择步骤后查看“说明”“执行”或“技术证据”；通过技术证据中的精确引用定位底层记录。
搜索与定位只改变焦点；“完整视图”恢复当前投影的全景。“资源”只在支持的视图中显示声明的依赖。
在 Basic 中用 /task ID status、/task ID result 查看任务状态与登记的结果。已结算记录或输出库所本身不能证明成功。

summary.en: A diagram combines declared structure and disclosed recorded state. Missing data is unknown, not zero.
summary.zh-CN: 图中同时展示声明的结构和获准披露的记录状态。缺少数据表示未知，不等于零。

en: Rectangular steps are transitions/agents; circles are places. Place numbers count active tokens; ? means the count was not provided.
Solid arrows consume or produce. Read arcs observe without consuming; reset arcs and resource dependencies have distinct line styles. Select an arc for exact mode and evidence.
Green task input and purple result output identify declared boundaries. They are not running/success indicators. A line bridge crosses another line without joining.
Unsettled means a record is not settled; started does not prove a process is still alive. Animation illustrates adjacent checkpoints, not new execution facts.
zh-CN: 矩形步骤表示 transition 或 agent；圆形表示库所。库所数字是有效 token 数；? 表示未提供计数。
实线弧表示消耗或产生；读取弧观察但不消耗；重置弧与资源依赖使用不同线型。选择弧可查看精确模式和证据。
绿色任务输入和紫色结果出口表示声明的边界，不代表运行中或成功。跳线跨过另一条线但不与其连接。
未结算表示记录尚未结算；started 不证明进程仍存活。动画只说明相邻 checkpoint 的变化，不是新的执行事实。

summary.en: Live refresh observes a run. A fresh HTTP response and a live task process are different facts.
summary.zh-CN: 实时刷新用于观察运行。HTTP 响应新鲜与任务进程存活是不同事实。

en: Check whether Live is enabled and whether you are viewing live position or a historical checkpoint. Returning to live changes only the viewing position.
If the page keeps the last complete frame after a read error, treat it as retained evidence; it may no longer be current. Use Refresh once after correcting the reported boundary.
A background/hidden tab may pause or slow observation. Bring it to the foreground before judging freshness; consult the status shown by the viewer.
If events stop, inspect the existing task status and result through the owner. Do not restart a task merely to make the viewer change.
zh-CN: 确认“实时”是否开启，以及当前是实时位置还是历史 checkpoint。返回实时只改变观看位置。
读取失败后保留的最后完整画面是已有证据，可能不再是当前状态。修正报告的问题边界后，再手动刷新一次。
后台或隐藏标签页可能暂停或减慢观察。判断新旧前先切回前台，并查看 Viewer 显示的状态。
若记录不再更新，通过原有 owner 的任务状态和结果入口检查。不要为了让图变化而重启任务。

summary.en: Replay changes what you inspect, not what the task executes. Its coverage is limited to available saved evidence.
summary.zh-CN: 回放改变查看的内容，不改变任务执行；范围以实际保存的证据为限。

en: Use the timeline to select a saved canonical checkpoint. Read the stated net/version and replay scope before interpreting a change.
Earlier records loads a bounded page when supported. If history is unavailable, it does not prove no work happened; the read provider may not support it.
Return to live explicitly. A running task can progress while you inspect history; the viewer should not silently pull your view away.
To continue real work, use the owner recovery commands and committed-checkpoint contract. Playing history is never resume or reopen.
zh-CN: 用时间轴选择保存的正式 checkpoint；解释变化前先核对所选网、版本及回放范围。
支持时，“更早记录”加载一个有界分页。历史不可用不证明没有发生工作，也可能是当前读取源不支持。
明确选择返回实时。查看历史期间任务仍可能前进；Viewer 不应静默抢回实时位置。
继续真实任务需要使用 owner 的恢复命令与已提交 checkpoint 契约。播放历史从来不是 resume 或 reopen。

summary.en: Checkpoint comparison and independent-net comparison answer different questions. Unknown correspondence is not an unchanged result.
summary.zh-CN: checkpoint 比较与独立网比较回答不同问题。对应关系未知不代表没有变化。

en: Compare checkpoints for saved states of the supported same-net scope. Compare independent nets for explicitly selected separate sources.
Read whether a pair is evidence-backed, manually aligned or unmatched. Manual alignment helps reading; it does not merge Registry identities.
Compare structure/configuration and runtime facts separately. Unknown or inaccessible sections cannot be counted as unchanged.
If alignment is unclear, use the available side-by-side/full-net view and inspect exact references. Do not edit records to force correspondence.
zh-CN: checkpoint 比较用于支持范围内同网的保存状态；独立网比较用于明确选择的不同来源。
确认配对是有证据支持、人工对照还是未匹配。人工对照只辅助阅读，不合并 Registry 身份。
分开理解结构、配置与运行事实。未知或无权读取的部分不能计为未变化。
对齐不清楚时，使用可用的并排或完整网视图检查精确引用。不要修改记录来强行建立对应。

summary.en: A connection failure identifies the local transport boundary; the underlying cause is not confirmed by the browser alone.
summary.zh-CN: 连接失败定位到本地传输边界；仅凭浏览器不能确定底层原因。

en: Open the exact loopback URL printed by the viewer process you started. A different hostname/port or proxy can be rejected even on the same computer.
Check whether that viewer process ended, its finite session lifetime expired, or the port is already occupied. Restart only the viewer against the same run when appropriate.
For an intentional persistent local session, inspect rpnh net --help and --session-timeout. Close the owning viewer process when finished; closing a tab is not a server shutdown.
Do not bind publicly, disable Host/Origin checks or forward a port to work around a connection failure. If the page loads but data fails, use the access or registry topic.
zh-CN: 打开自己启动的 Viewer 进程打印的精确 loopback 地址。即使在同一电脑，换主机名、端口或代理也可能被拒绝。
检查该 Viewer 进程是否结束、有限会话时长是否到期，或端口是否占用。适当时只针对同一运行重新打开 Viewer。
确需本机持续监听时，查看 rpnh net --help 中的 --session-timeout。用完关闭所属 Viewer 进程；关闭标签页不等于关闭服务器。
不要通过公开绑定、关闭 Host/Origin 检查或转发端口来绕过连接问题。页面能打开但数据失败时，查看 access 或 registry 主题。

summary.en: Denied, stale and unsupported are distinct read outcomes. The helper cannot grant access or infer hidden data.
summary.zh-CN: 拒绝、观察过期与不支持是不同的读取结果。helper 无法授予权限或推断隐藏数据。

en: Read the status/category shown by the failing panel. HTTP 403 means this request was refused; it does not by itself prove a particular permission configuration is wrong.
After source scope or permission changes, reselect the authorized source through the existing read interface. Do not reuse a stale comparison or observation cursor.
A 404/501 may indicate that the selected provider does not expose this resource/capability. Use supported views and preserve the unavailable status.
Inspect the curated source boundary below and the local owner configuration. Never remove Registry locks, edit identities or disable read validation to obtain a view.
zh-CN: 查看失败面板显示的状态或类别。HTTP 403 表示本次请求被拒绝，不能单凭它确定某项权限配置错误。
来源范围或权限变化后，通过既有读取入口重新选择获授权来源，不复用过期的比较或观察游标。
404 或 501 可能表示读取源未暴露该资源或能力。使用支持的视图，并保留不可用状态。
检查下方列出的源码边界及本地 owner 配置。不要删除 Registry 锁、修改身份或关闭读取校验来强行查看。

summary.en: A projection failure can originate in the read binding, Registry records or incompatible code. The cause remains unconfirmed until checked.
summary.zh-CN: 投影失败可能来自读取绑定、Registry 记录或代码不兼容；检查前原因仍未确认。

en: Record the failing operation, visible HTTP/category, exact selected run and installed source revision privately. Do not publish raw Registry files or logs.
Check that the run/profile identity and schema are supported by the installed code. Use the original exact profile; do not relabel historical records.
For a read-HOST selection, use its existing preflight/describe entry before an object query. This is separate from model configuration and task execution.
Preserve the Registry and external-effect evidence. If work itself failed, use recovery/provider guidance; refreshing the browser cannot repair settlement.
zh-CN: 私下记录失败操作、可见 HTTP 或类别、精确运行选择及安装版本。不要公开原始 Registry 文件或日志。
检查安装代码是否支持该运行、profile 身份及 schema。使用原有精确 profile，不重新标记历史记录。
使用 read-HOST 时，先通过既有 preflight 或 describe 入口检查，再查询对象；它与模型配置、任务执行独立。
保留 Registry 与外部效果证据。任务本身失败时查看 recovery 或 provider；刷新浏览器不能修复结算。

title.zh-CN: 从已提交 checkpoint 继续

summary.en: Recovery uses Registry authority and a valid committed checkpoint. It does not continue arbitrarily from a failed operation.
summary.zh-CN: 恢复使用 Registry 权威和有效的已提交 checkpoint，不是任意从失败操作接着执行。

en: For a paused main turn, /resume continues or settles terminal evidence. /rollback returns main conversation authority to its prior completed turn and retains child evidence.
For a selected child, /resume uses that task owner. /task ID checkpoints lists supported saved cuts; reopen CHECKPOINT is an explicit earlier-generation choice.
Resolve an existing owner/writer conflict through the original owner. Do not clear locks or start a competing writer.
Inspect post-checkpoint external effects before retrying. Local restore does not undo a remote write, provider charge or settled external effect. The viewer never performs recovery.
zh-CN: 主会话暂停时，/resume 用于继续或结算终态证据；/rollback 将主会话权威退回上一已完成轮次，并保留子任务证据。
选中子任务时，/resume 使用该任务 owner。/task ID checkpoints 列出支持的保存切点；reopen CHECKPOINT 是明确选择更早切点的新代次。
通过原 owner 解决已有 owner 或 writer 冲突，不删除锁或启动竞争 writer。
重试前核对 checkpoint 之后的外部效果。本地恢复不会撤销远端写入、模型费用或已结算的外部效果；Viewer 从不执行恢复。

summary.en: Provider or model failures are execution/configuration problems, not something the viewer can repair.
summary.zh-CN: provider 或模型失败属于执行或配置问题，Viewer 不能修复。

en: Run rpnh doctor for an offline configuration check. Ready means local checks passed; it does not prove credential validity or provider reachability.
Verify the exact saved provider/model/route and required environment variable names. Do not print credential values, private endpoints or the full environment.
A timeout can leave submission or effect status unknown. Preserve the recorded attempt and inspect the boundary before deciding whether a new call is safe.
Use rpnh config --help for available configuration commands. Resume keeps the persisted exact profile; do not silently switch model or retry via another provider.
zh-CN: 运行 rpnh doctor 进行离线配置检查。ready 只表示本地检查通过，不证明凭据有效或 provider 可达。
核对已保存的精确 provider、模型、路由及所需环境变量名；不要输出密钥值、私有 endpoint 或完整环境。
超时可能使提交或效果状态未知。保留已记录的尝试，检查效果边界后再判断是否可以新调用。
用 rpnh config --help 查看可用配置命令。恢复沿用持久化的精确 profile，不静默换模型或改 provider 重试。

summary.en: Missing or incompatible local assets can prevent rendering before run data is read. This does not establish that the run failed.
summary.zh-CN: 本地展示资产缺失或不匹配可能在读取运行数据前阻止渲染；这不说明任务运行失败。

en: Check that HTML, app modules and bundled rendering/worker assets come from the same complete installed source/wheel.
Reload the exact local viewer URL after correcting the installation. Do not mix assets from a CDN, another branch or a downloaded script.
Use the terminal projection (rpnh net --run RUN_DIR) to inspect available run evidence while repairing presentation. Replace RUN_DIR with the existing run; this command does not start it.
If reporting a browser console/network error, share only the failing asset name and status after review. Do not paste run payloads, secrets or full local paths.
zh-CN: 确认 HTML、app 模块、渲染库和 worker 资产来自同一份完整源码或 wheel。
修正安装后重新加载精确本地 Viewer 地址，不混用 CDN、其它分支或单独下载脚本的资产。
修复展示期间，可用终端投影 rpnh net --run RUN_DIR 查看现有证据。将 RUN_DIR 替换为已有运行目录；命令不会启动任务。
反馈浏览器 console 或 network 错误时，审核后只提供失败资产名与状态，不粘贴运行载荷、密钥或完整本地路径。

title.en: Find a hidden or slow graph
title.zh-CN: 定位看不见或缓慢的图

summary.en: An empty canvas can be a filtered projection, unavailable data or a layout failure. Check the visible category before concluding the net is empty.
summary.zh-CN: 空画布可能是筛选投影、数据不可用或布局失败。先检查可见类别，再判断网是否为空。

en: Clear search, choose Fit to view and check the selected information level. An agent-only Overview can legitimately be empty when no agents are declared; open PetriNet for actual structure.
Use Executions or the terminal projection to inspect available records without relying on a large canvas. A resource-only view can be empty when no resources are declared.
If the page reports a layout/worker failure, check the matching local worker asset and use the assets topic. Do not infer data loss from a rendering error.
For a large run, retain bounded history/firing options and inspect a smaller supported scope. Increasing every limit can increase memory and latency; measure before changing them.
zh-CN: 清除搜索、选择“完整视图”并检查信息层级。未声明 agent 时，agent 概览可能合理地为空；打开 PetriNet 查看真实结构。
使用“执行列表”或终端投影查看可用记录，避免依赖大画布。未声明资源时，纯资源视图可以为空。
若页面报告布局或 worker 失败，检查匹配的本地 worker 资产，并查看 assets 主题。不能由渲染错误推断数据丢失。
大运行应保留历史和 firing 的有界选项，检查支持的较小范围。扩大所有限制会增加内存与延迟，应先测量再调整。
